question: Barapani Lake of Shillong is also known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Umiam Lake**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Umiam Lake**, located in Shillong, Meghalaya, is popularly referred to as **Barapani Lake**. It is a man-made reservoir created in the early 1960s.
 
• The lake was formed by constructing the **Umiam Dam** on the Umiam River as part of a hydroelectric project.
 
• **Barapani Lake** is a major tourist attraction in Shillong and is known for its serene beauty and the surrounding lush green hills.
 
• The lake serves multiple purposes, including **water storage, hydropower generation**, and providing a source of irrigation to nearby areas.
 
• Its picturesque location also makes it a popular spot for **water sports and recreational activities**, such as kayaking, boating, and angling.
 
• The lake holds ecological significance, contributing to **groundwater recharge** and supporting the local biodiversity of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shilloi Lake:**

 
 
• **Shilloi Lake** is located in Nagaland, India. Unlike Umiam Lake, it is a natural lake surrounded by hills.
 
• The lake holds cultural significance for the locals, as they believe it to be a sacred site.
 
• It is not connected to Shillong or referred to as Barapani Lake.
 
 
 
• **Haflong Lake:**
 
 
• **Haflong Lake** is situated in Assam and is one of the largest natural water bodies in the state.
 
• It is located in Haflong town, the only hill station in Assam, and serves as a popular tourist destination.
 
• It is not related to Shillong or Umiam Lake.
 
 
 
• **Jaisamand Lake:**
 
 
• **Jaisamand Lake**, also known as Dhebar Lake, is located in Rajasthan and is one of the largest artificial lakes in India.
 
• The lake was built by Maharana Jai Singh in the 17th century and is surrounded by the Jaisamand Wildlife Sanctuary.
 
• It is entirely unrelated to Shillong or Barapani Lake.
 
 
 
• **Geographical Significance of Umiam Lake:**
 
 
• Umiam Lake spans over **220 square kilometers**, making it one of the largest artificial reservoirs in Meghalaya.
 
• The lake contributes to the scenic beauty of Meghalaya and is often called the “**Scotland of the East**” due to its resemblance to Scottish landscapes.
 
• The lake has a catchment area of about **225 square kilometers**, which includes dense forests and rolling meadows.
 
 
 
• **Important Attractions around Umiam Lake:**
 
 
• The lake is surrounded by resorts and recreational facilities, including the famous **Umiam Lake Boathouse**, which offers boating and other activities for tourists.
 
• It is also home to the **Meghalaya Rural Tourism Centre**, which promotes eco-tourism and local handicrafts.
 
• Visitors can enjoy trekking in the nearby hills or simply relax and enjoy the breathtaking views of the lake.
